texts.preamble: Narayan Chandra Dhar vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 6 August, 2025 06-08-2025 Item No.194 Ml In The High Court At Calcutta Subrata Constitutional Writ Jurisdiction Bhattacharyya Appellate Side Ar(C) Wpa No.13330 of 2025 Narayan Chandra Dhar -vs- The State of West Bengal & Ors. Mr. Pradip Kumar Kundu Mr. Kingsuk Mondal ...for the petitioner Mr. Biswabrata Basu Mallick, Agp Mr. Biman Halder Mr. Sayak Chakraborty ...for the State Ms. Sudipa Banerjee ...for the private respondents 1.
texts.facts: The petitioner alleges that the private respondents are running a kitchen industry from the residential premises which is occupied both by the petitioner and the private respondents who are the co-owners of the subject property. 2. The allegation is that the private respondents are running the business without obtaining proper licence/fire safety certificate/pollution under control certificate and other permits from the competent authority. 3. Objection was filed before the New Barrackpore Municipality and also before the District Magistrate, North 24 Parganas. It is alleged that there is no response from the end of the authorities. Copy of the permanent certificate of enlistment issued by the New Barrackpore Municipality dated October 31, 2024 for carrying on business of restaurant or eating house or selling of food items and a permanent certificate of enlistment dated May 15, 2025 for running catering service, a licence by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India issued on June 4, 2025 have been placed before this Court.
texts.arguments: 4. Learned counsel for the private respondents submits that all necessary permissions have been obtained from the competent authority for running a cloud kitchen at the subject place. 5. Learned counsel for the State relies upon the instructions forwarded by the Officer-in-Charge of New Barrackpore police station signed on June 24, 2025 wherefrom it appears that, on inspection, the private respondents were unable to produce the pollution control clearance certificate or licence.
